videos.title: How Image Watermarking Works - Computerphile
videos.author: Computerphile
videos.description:
Image watermarks are a way to embed information into a picture, Dr Mike Pound takes us through Adobe's Trust Mark to explain the idea & covers some of the pros and cons.

videos.author: Computerphile
videos.description:
Using the example of a flight simulator to discuss the complexities of coding a multi-player game. What data do you send? When do you send it & how often? Dr Julian Onions talks about his experiences of working on a flight simulator.
